mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_attempts( session_id, user_id, user_vocabulary_entry_id, word_notebook_entry_id, public_entry_id, prompt_type, prompt_text, option_a, option_a_word, option_a_meaning_cn, option_b, option_b_word, option_b_meaning_cn, option_c, option_c_word, option_c_meaning_cn, option_d, option_d_word, option_d_meaning_cn, correct_option, wrong_submissions, created_at ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{userVocabularyEntryId}, #{wordNotebookEntryId}, #{publicEntryId}, #{promptType}, #{promptText}, #{optionA}, #{optionAWord}, #{optionAMeaningCn}, #{optionB}, #{optionBWord}, #{optionBMeaningCn}, #{optionC}, #{optionCWord}, #{optionCMeaningCn}, #{optionD}, #{optionDWord}, #{optionDMeaningCn}, #{correctOption}, #{wrongSubmissions}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_vocabulary_entry_id AS userVocabularyEntryId, word_notebook_entry_id AS wordNotebookEntryId, public_entry_id AS publicEntryId, correct_option AS correctOption, selected_option AS selectedOption, wrong_submissions AS wrongSubmissions FROM quiz_attempts WHERE id = #{attemptId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT qa.id, qa.user_vocabulary_entry_id AS userVocabularyEntryId, qa.word_notebook_entry_id AS wordNotebookEntryId, qa.public_entry_id AS publicEntryId, qa.prompt_type AS promptType, qa.prompt_text AS promptText, CASE WHEN qa.prompt_type = 'CN_TO_EN' THEN qa.correct_option ELSE qa.prompt_text END AS currentWord, COALESCE(pv.phonetic, uv.phonetic, wne.phonetic, '') AS phonetic, COALESCE(pv.audio_url, uv.audio_url, '') AS audioUrl, qa.option_a AS optionA, qa.option_a_word AS optionAWord, qa.option_a_meaning_cn AS optionAMeaningCn, qa.option_b AS optionB, qa.option_b_word AS optionBWord, qa.option_b_meaning_cn AS optionBMeaningCn, qa.option_c AS optionC, qa.option_c_word AS optionCWord, qa.option_c_meaning_cn AS optionCMeaningCn, qa.option_d AS optionD, qa.option_d_word AS optionDWord, qa.option_d_meaning_cn AS optionDMeaningCn, qa.correct_option AS correctOption FROM quiz_attempts qa LEFT JOIN public_vocabulary_entries pv ON pv.id = qa.public_entry_id LEFT JOIN user_vocabulary_entries uv ON uv.id = qa.user_vocabulary_entry_id LEFT JOIN word_notebook_entries wne ON wne.id = qa.word_notebook_entry_id WHERE qa.session_id = #{sessionId} AND qa.selected_option IS NULL ORDER BY qa.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE quiz_attempts SET prompt_text = #{promptText}, option_a = #{optionA}, option_a_word = #{optionAWord}, option_a_meaning_cn = #{optionAMeaningCn}, option_b = #{optionB}, option_b_word = #{optionBWord}, option_b_meaning_cn = #{optionBMeaningCn}, option_c = #{optionC}, option_c_word = #{optionCWord}, option_c_meaning_cn = #{optionCMeaningCn}, option_d = #{optionD}, option_d_word = #{optionDWord}, option_d_meaning_cn = #{optionDMeaningCn}, correct_option = #{correctOption} WHERE id = #{attemptId} AND selected_option IS NULL
